name: Gasthof Geislerhof
beschreibung: The Gasthof Geislerhof is nestled on the slopes of the Tux Alps. The building blends traditional Tyrolean architecture with a quiet, scenic setting. Guests can look forward to a multi-storey house with guest rooms furnished with local wood. The surrounding area offers marked hiking trails into the Zillertal valley as well as winter walking paths. Amenities include an on-site restaurant serving regional cuisine and a lounge featuring a traditional tiled stove. In fine weather, the beer garden invites you to relax outdoors. Rooms are equipped with shower, WC, and satellite TV. Towels and bed linen are included in the room rate.
